text:
sam: FYI I'm scheduling kernel v3.14.2-quant into the 'night' bucket at 00:30 PT. This build includes a new eviction heuristic for KV cache. I'll pin runtime:stable->runtime:stable@2026-03-21-71 for shards that show early flaps.
anya: Can you share the eviction thresholds you'll be using? we saw OOM-like mem spikes last time.
miguel: I'm concerned — latest perf tests show mem_rss up ~12% when batch_factor>=8 with the new allocator. Suggest lowering batch_factor to 6 for night slice and enable early-drain.
sam: Good catch. Default batch_factor -> 6 for night. Also setting eviction_threshold=0.78 (was 0.85).
deploybot: scheduled rollout: night-region-1 @ 1718056200 -> night-region-2 @ 1718057400. Pin command available.
sam: deploybot pin cmd: `deploybot pin --service runtime --version v3.14.2-quant --scope shard:night-* --ttl 3h`
lee: Who owns rollback if we see tail latencies spike? I'm on call until 02:30 PT.
anya: I'll monitor p99 and CPU load (watcher runbook). Rollback criteria: error_rate > 0.5% for 5m OR p99_latency increase >30ms sustained 5m OR memory OOM events on >2 hosts in a shard.
miguel: Add one more: evictions/sec > 50 sustained 3m -> signal for rollback or immediate throttle.
ops-bot: smoke-check: pre-deploy baseline: p50=7ms p95=42ms p99=120ms mem_rss=14.8GB
sam: post-deploy plan: run canary on 2% traffic for 10m, then 10% for 15m if green, then ramp. If any rollback signal: immediate pin to previous runtime and cut traffic.
deploybot: note: release-notes link: https://redwood.internal/releases/v3.14.2-quant - please add known caveats under 'nightly' heading.
anya: I'll add items: 'eviction threshold lowered', 'batch_factor default 6 for night', 'hotfix for allocator fragmenting'.
miguel: I'll prepare a mitigations gist with `--batch-factor` knob and commands to force-evict.
sam: Final decisions: batch_factor=6, eviction_threshold=0.78, pin-ttl=3h, rollback_criteria as above. @lee and @anya are on monitoring. I'll trigger at 00:30 PT. :thumbsup:
lee: noted, will be watching, ping me in #eng-oncall if anything.
deploybot: deploy event created: https://deploys.internal/1718054321 - schedule set
sam: thanks everyone — will DM if we need immediate rollback.
